# Gas and Oil Recruitment

> British international recruiter (Abarrane Limited; public face Peter Smith) placing Western senior oil & gas, mining and EPCM people into Saudi Arabia — especially Riyadh — and serving existing GCC markets from one brand hub. High-ticket, scarce roles only. Staging site is noindex until the owner authorises go-live.

## Positioning
Gas and Oil Recruitment is a specialist energy desk, not a volume Gulf job board. We send Western engineers and senior personnel into the Gulf one-by-one or in bulk, contract or permanent, where the role is scarce and quota allows. We do not promise to bypass Saudization. Engineering localisation of 30% across 46 professions (SCE accreditation; SAR 8,000 floor) has been in force since 30 June 2026. Project-management professions face 70% localisation from 14 February 2027.

The home-page primary query is “international recruitment agencies in Saudi Arabia” (British proxy). “Recruitment agencies in Saudi Arabia” is a mixed-intent hub term only — not the #1 bet. The generic “oil and gas recruitment agencies in Saudi Arabia” string is contested and is not a money page; that URL 308s to home.

British / UK / London language is trust copy for Western-HQ buyers (oil and gas recruitment agency; mining recruitment agency; energy executive search). It lives on the home page, not as extra URLs.

Saudi Arabia (Riyadh and the Kingdom) is the target market. We also place into Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Bahrain and Qatar from this same hub.
